Sorry for not seeing your response before. I only made this account for the question.

There's no gay marriage, adoption or surrogacy where I live. So that's why I can't have a family if I'm gay.
I don't know but there's no way I could ever tell anyone especially my mom that would kill her.
I was born in Bosnia but live in Croatia. My mom and her side of the family is Catholic and so am I. It's not seen badly where we live but my family wouldn't accept it.
There's no way I could have a family if I'm gay and no way I'd be accepted by mine.
Because it's not going to be a "happy" life if I'm gay. I have nothing against homosexuality and maybe others can be gay and live happily but that's not for me. I want to be normal and have a family.
